소재에서 출발하는 라인: A line that starts from the material
COCODEMER BiO does not begin with the product.
다룰 수 있는 소재를 먼저 확보하고, 그 소재가 가장 잘 작동하는 자리를: We secure a material we can work with, then find where it works best.
일반 스킨케어가 사용 순서에 맞춰 설계된다면, 바이오는 소재의 성질에서: Where our general skincare is designed around the order of use, BiO starts from the properties of the material itself. We first establish the concentration and the vehicle in which a material actually means something, and only then decide what form the product takes.
직접 소싱하고 검증한 소재를 출발점으로 삼습니다. 완제품 기획이 아니라: We start from materials we have sourced and verified ourselves. Securing the material comes before planning the finished product.
소재가 의미를 갖는 농도 구간을 먼저 정하고, 그 조건을 지킬 수 있는: We first establish the concentration range at which a material is meaningful, then choose a formulation that can hold those conditions.
It will be developed separately from the general skincare system, as a BiO lineup in its own right.
※ 라인 구성과 출시 시점은 미정입니다. 소재 제안 · 공동 개발 문의는: ※ The composition of the line and its launch timing are not yet fixed. For material proposals and joint-development enquiries, please use the B2B enquiry form.
바이오 이름으로 먼저 선보였던 제품입니다. 현재는 판매되지 않으며, 처방: The product first released under the BiO name. It is no longer offered for sale; the formulation and component records are retained.
보유하신 소재를 바이오 라인에 제안하시거나, 공동 개발 · OEM 형태의: If you would like to propose a material for the BiO line, or are considering joint development or OEM collaboration, please get in touch.
코코드메르 바이오는 자사가 확보한 소재에서 출발합니다. 일반 스킨케어 시: COCODEMER BiO starts from materials we have secured ourselves. It will be developed separately from the general skincare system, as a lineup of its own.
제품을 먼저 정하지 않고, 다룰 수 있는 소재를 먼저 확보합니다. 소재가: Rather than deciding the product first, we secure a material we can work with, and design the formulation at the concentration where that material is meaningful.
